scale_cues: Square white dinner plate assumed to be about 26 cm per side, filling most of the frame; green bean length (about 8-10 cm each) used as a secondary check. Food covers roughly the top third of the plate.
assumptions: Only the food on the central square plate is logged; the olives, cherry tomatoes and shredded carrot on the partially visible plate at the left edge are treated as a separate dish and excluded.
The meat is taken to be sliced beef steak; it could instead be pork or lamb.
The topping on the meat (crumbs and tomato bits) is included in the meat mass rather than listed separately.
The dark pieces under the rice are assumed to be mushrooms; they could be additional meat or eggplant.
The grain is assumed to be brown rice based on its tan colour; it could be white rice coated in sauce.
Cooking oil is not directly visible and is estimated from the sheen and browning on the vegetables and meat.
